jobs.name: 01_cookie_crumb_first_frame
jobs.prompt:
Take the chibi character from this image and place her in a COMPLETELY NEW SCENE. This is not a retouch: rebuild the environment and her pose.

CHANGE THE ENVIRONMENT: remove the black desk mat, remove the tape dispenser, remove the pen cup. She now stands directly on bare polished wooden desk planks. Add one real white ceramic coffee mug with a visible handle standing on the LEFT side of frame, tall enough that she reaches only about one third of its height. Softly blurred warm room background, natural daylight coming from the right.

CHANGE HER POSE AND PROPS: she now hugs one single golden-brown cookie crumb, as big as her own torso, pressed against her chest with both arms wrapped tightly around it. Both hands grip the crumb. Her expression changes to a proud, smug closed-mouth smile with eyes wide open looking straight at the camera.

KEEP THE CHARACTER EXACTLY AS DRAWN: same face, same violet-lavender eyes, same cream-blonde wavy hair with mint tips, same black headband with mint lightning bolt, same butterfly-wing hair ornament, same dark tailcoat with gold filigree, same golden-yellow neck scarf, same white gloves with gold cuffs, same mint layered skirt with white panels, same black tights and gold-trimmed boots, same crisp 2.5D cel-shaded lineart, same chibi proportions.

Vertical 9:16 macro photo at seated eye level. She fills a large portion of the frame and casts a soft contact shadow plus a short cast shadow on the wood. The desk, mug and background stay fully photorealistic, never cel-shaded. No text, no watermark, no human hands, no extra characters.
